decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham builds directly on the firm's core ham know-how and certified organic system, and it fits the strategic push to expand organic lines, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it.
Organic Kasseler uses established curing and smoking expertise within the organic range the firm intends to grow, so it is easy to assimilate and adjust.
Organic pepper salami draws on the firm's large maturation facilities and seasoning know-how, giving it a strong knowledge base to sustain and improve the product.

The teriyaki aspic draws on core aspic skills but adds an exotic flavour far from the firm's traditional recipe knowledge, making its niche deli-counter results harder to read, so it is the most vulnerable product, though the case for keeping it narrowly holds.
Fennel salami (finocchiona style) is a flavour variation on established salami production with its own dedicated page, so it remains close to existing capabilities despite some niche risk.
A classic liver pâté with veal sits squarely within the firm's pâté expertise and traditional recipes, so it is easy to manage and refine.
